rule: Attitude: root stances (friendly, neutral, hostile) override; same root gives friendly; a sub-faction defers to its mother's relation table; otherwise its own table, default neutral. CanAttack: safe-zone protection by mother faction (lifted by active hostility or the Retribution flag), otherwise attackable only when hostile. Crime: per-evidence jail minutes (murder 20, theft 8, assault 0), x10 for victims below level 30, times an infamy factor (defect: integer division), pirate fixed 40 (defect: can exceed 40 after grade multiplier). Verdict: five-seat vote maps to a grade 0 to 6; grades 2 to 6 are multipliers 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2 of the base. Trial steps on timers (init 10 s, summons 2 min skipped if queue empty, confirm 5 min, closing 1 min, verdict 1 min, end 1 min on the normal path). Greeting: NPC bubble per player per 5 minutes within range, line weight capped by player level (under 15: 500, under 30: 300, under 45: 200, else 60).
keep: Three root stances that override a sub-faction, with a directional view for each viewer.
Zone faction protects its own citizens, with the active-hostility and flag exceptions.
Wanted state as three values: clean, wanted, held for trial.
Five-grade verdict from a vote count, each grade a fixed multiple of the base sentence.
Level-capped greeting bubble with a per-player cooldown.
Trial steps driven by one timer table, with an early skip when the jury queue is empty.
change: Infamy factor as a real division (fix integer division).
Clamp the pirate sentence after the grade multiplier.
Hold the verify step for its full timer on the server.
Choose one end-of-trial constant and name it.
Unknown relation defaults to neutral, with validation at load.
CanAttack fails closed when a faction is missing.
Dominion claim check and an applied tax-rate update (both missing).
Replace all faction, place and bubble names with originals; drop the court screen for 375 wide duels.

Compare the lines an NPC gives a level 5 and a level 40 character (wording is the team's, the weight cap is the rule). Check on 375 wide whether the safe zone and the wanted mark read in one glance.
